title: WEATHER FORECAST FOR 03 May 2026 Issued at 2.00 p.m. on 02 May 2026 Showers or thundershowers will occur at several places in the Western, Sabaragamuwa, Central, Uva, North-central and Eastern provinces and in Galle and Matara districts after 1.00 pm. Showers are likely in coastal areas of Southern province and in Kaluthara and Colombo districts during the morning too. Misty conditions can be expected at some places in Central, Sabaragamuwa and Uva provinces and in Ampara district during the early hours of the morning. The general public is kindly requested to take adequate precautions to minimize damages caused by temporary localized strong winds and lightning during thundershowers.
